description: This file is a shell script used to configure, initialize, and manage a network protocol named 'unet' for OpenWRT. It includes functions for setting up and tearing down the protocol, managing configuration parameters, and interfacing with other system components via JSON and ubus.

methods.name: proto_unet_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration schema for the 'unet' protocol by defining expected fields and their types.

methods.name: add_array
methods.description: Adds an array of strings to the JSON object for configuration purposes.

methods.name: proto_unet_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 'unet' protocol, applying configuration parameters, creating network interfaces, and registering the network with the system.

methods.name: proto_unet_teardown
methods.description: Removes the 'unet' network interface and cleans up the configuration.
